description: Treasury reports CAD 0 available and no verified revenue. Feedback shows no classified requests and five unclassified sources, so demand remains unknown. The CanadaBuys open-notice file exceeded the fetch limit, and the 30 new notices produced zero matches in the title and description screens. That supports closing this bounded screen after evidence readback and reopening it when a readable original notice identifies separately quotable work. Independently, move the SQLite download toward checkout by verifying the replacement archive when it commits. A file-specific rights gap affects that archive, while seller activation and payout require separate evidence. Any public release still requires host-enforced independent approval of the exact digest.
